resolved_during_review.title: Count distinct preserved holds when multiple quarantines belong to one run
resolved_during_review.body: For two valid quarantine descriptors with distinct attempt/reservation/output/intent IDs on the same failed run, the checker accepts runs[failed].pending_reservations=1. Each descriptor independently checks only >=1, although the receipt itself preserves two distinct pending reservation IDs. This understates the declared run pending count. Both full reservation values remain in descriptors, so this probe does not establish a numeric-budget or product-acceptance bypass.

Leave failed-run pending_reservations at 1. scoped_evidence_accounting returns the fresh selected scope.

resolved_during_review.after: Exact pending count must equal distinct quarantined reservation count for its failed run. Underreported and overreported counts reject; correct count accepts. Mixed original ledger IDs reject at lines 899-900.
